name: pilotfish-parallel
description: Run independent Codex repository jobs concurrently in isolated Git worktrees and integrate them all-or-nothing with final adversarial verification.

interface.shortDescription: Parallel Codex writers with isolated worktrees
interface.longDescription: Runs two or three genuinely independent Codex jobs concurrently in isolated Git worktrees, validates disjoint write scopes, integrates snapshots all-or-nothing, and uses a fresh read-only xhigh Verifier for the final decision.

平行完成這些不重疊任務並做最終驗證
